metadata.stopping: Residual objective: ftol=gtol=0 and common feasible canonical t residual <=1e-12; shifted Gram: ftol=1e-15, chart gtol=1e-12.
metadata.timing: One serial measurement per run with library threads fixed to one. Timings include optimizer and diagnostics used during iterations, exclude endpoint high-precision and refinement validation. Host idle state is not certified; times are descriptive only.
